mechanisms.label: Diesel / refining crisis
mechanisms.summary: The available evidence does not conclusively show that middle‑distillate scarcity is tightening independently of crude supply. Official U.S. diesel price data were published on 22 Sep 2026, but the accompanying article does not provide the price level. Market reports from Quantum Commodity Intelligence indicate that, on 24 Sep 2026, Brent and LSGO prices were higher (suggesting elevated diesel/jet premiums) while Singapore distillate cracks were slumping, and on 25 Sep 2026 HOGO prices flattened. These mixed signals imply that any tightening of distillate markets is not clearly driven by a crude shortage.
